name: yarn-modern

allocations.name: yarn-global
allocations.purpose: Modern Yarn global packages and mirror

notes: Inspect enableGlobalCache. When false, keep the project's cacheFolder (especially checked-in zero-install .yarn/cache); globalFolder relocates the mirror. Do not force enableGlobalCache or change PnP/nodeLinker, yarnPath, checksums, immutable flags or project scripts to make tests pass. globalFolder is shared only for versions supporting concurrent cache use. Existing Corepack may need its own COREPACK_HOME state allocation; do not run Corepack enable or update host package-manager shims.
